title: She Never Gave Us the Answer

pre.en: What did Ms Gao do when Chen sent her his app's code?
pre.zh: 小陈把 App 的代码发给高老师后，她做了什么？
options: She asked him to visit the lab.
She found a bug in it.

intro: 一篇人物小传：小陈大学时的编程老师高老师。她从不直接给答案，却让几百个学生学会了写代码。读的时候留意几个固定说法后面都接 doing：have trouble understanding、spend three hours answering、It's worth writing。结尾她只回了一句话。

sentences.en: Ms Gao taught programming at Chen's university in Chengdu for twenty-five years.
sentences.zh: 高老师在小陈读书的成都那所大学教了二十五年编程。

sentences.en: Chen says she's the reason he writes code today.
sentences.zh: 小陈说，他今天能写代码，全是因为她。

sentences.en: In his first year, he had trouble understanding loops.
sentences.zh: 大一那年，他怎么都搞不懂循环。

sentences.en: He spent whole weekends staring at error messages.
sentences.zh: 好几个周末都是整天盯着报错信息发呆。

sentences.en: On day one, she showed the new students around the lab.
sentences.zh: 开学第一天，她带新生参观机房。

sentences.en: "You'll all get stuck," she told them.
sentences.zh: 「你们都会卡住，」她说，

sentences.en: "That's normal."
sentences.zh: 「这很正常。」

sentences.en: She was patient with beginners and often went out of her way to help them.
sentences.zh: 她对初学者很有耐心，还常常特意抽时间帮他们。

sentences.en: Every Saturday morning, she opened the empty lab and spent three hours answering questions from anyone who turned up.
sentences.zh: 每个星期六上午，她都会打开空荡荡的机房，谁来了就给谁答疑，一答就是三个小时。

sentences.en: Usually with more questions.
sentences.zh: 而且通常是拿更多的问题来回答问题。

sentences.en: She made students pay attention to every error message.
sentences.zh: 她要求学生认真看每一条报错信息。

sentences.en: "What does it say? Read it again. Slowly."
sentences.zh: 「它说的什么？再读一遍。慢慢读。」

sentences.en: She didn't mind repeating herself.
sentences.zh: 她不嫌重复。

sentences.en: She was used to asking the same thing ten times.
sentences.zh: 同一个问题问上十遍，她早就习惯了。

sentences.en: "It's worth writing it on paper first," she always said.
sentences.zh: 「先在纸上写一遍，多花这功夫绝对值，」她总这么说。

sentences.en: And, "Learn from your mistakes. You'll make plenty."
sentences.zh: 还有：「要从错误里学。你们会犯很多错的。」

sentences.en: She made it clear that she'd never give you the answer.
sentences.zh: 她早就说明白了：答案她是绝不会直接给你的。

sentences.en: She'd only point you in the right direction.
sentences.zh: 她只会给你指个方向。

sentences.en: Chen used to think this was cruel.
sentences.zh: 小陈以前觉得这样太狠了。

sentences.en: She was good at getting her message across without saying much.
sentences.zh: 她很会用不多的几句话把意思讲明白。

sentences.en: When Chen was ill for a month, she helped him catch up.
sentences.zh: 小陈病了一个月，是她帮他把落下的课补上的。

sentences.en: Before exams, she told nervous students to take it easy.
sentences.zh: 考试前，她会让紧张的学生放轻松。

sentences.en: And after every session, everyone had to tidy up.
sentences.zh: 每次课后，所有人都得把桌面收拾干净。

sentences.en: Hundreds of her old students now work abroad, and she made a difference to every one of them.
sentences.zh: 她教过的学生里，光在国外工作的就有好几百个，每一个都受过她的影响。

sentences.en: Last year, Chen sent her a link to his app's code.
sentences.zh: 去年，小陈把自己 App 的代码链接发给了她。

sentences.en: She replied in one line: "Nice. Line 214 has a bug."
sentences.zh: 她只回了一行：「不错。第 214 行有个 bug。」

cards.note: program 是程序，programming 是编程这门手艺；programmer 是程序员。
编程里让一段代码重复执行的结构，比如 for loop；平时也指「圈、环」。
stare at sth 长时间盯着；比 look at 时间长，常带「看不懂、发愣」的意思。

cards.zh: 带某人参观；带某人四处转转
cards.note: to take someone to see the different parts of a place
to be unable to move, or unable to continue with something
to stay calm and not get angry when someone is slow or makes mistakes
cards.tip: 对人用 with；对事也可以用 about：be patient about the results。反义 impatient。
cards.example: Be patient with him — it's only his second week.

cards.text: go out of your way to do
cards.note: to make a special effort to do something, especially to help someone
cards.tip: your 要跟着主语变：she went out of her way、they went out of their way；后面接 to do。
cards.example: The hotel staff went out of their way to make us feel welcome.

cards.note: laboratory 的简称；computer lab 就是机房。
to arrive, often late or when people are not sure you will come
to watch, listen to or think about something carefully
cards.tip: to 是介词，后面接名词或 doing；不说 pay attention on。
cards.example: Please pay attention to the warning signs.

cards.note: repeat yourself 是「把自己说过的话再说一遍」；Could you repeat that? 请再说一遍。
to understand what you did wrong so that you do better next time
cards.tip: your 跟着主语变：he learned from his mistakes。犯错是 make a mistake，不说 do a mistake。
cards.example: Everyone gets things wrong — the important thing is to learn from your mistakes.

cards.note: to say or show something in a way that people cannot misunderstand
cards.tip: it 指后面 that 引出的内容；把立场、规矩先说在前头。
cards.example: Please make it clear in the ticket which version you tested.

cards.text: point sb in the right direction
cards.zh: 给某人指个方向；点拨一下
cards.note: to give someone a little help or advice so they can find the answer themselves
cards.tip: 人放在 point 后面；只给思路，不给答案，所以很适合请教别人时客气地说。
cards.example: I don't need the full answer — can you just point me in the right direction?

cards.note: 这里是半开玩笑的夸张：不给答案，在学生看来简直「太狠了」。

cards.zh: 把意思讲清楚；让人听明白
cards.note: to make people understand what you want to tell them
cards.tip: your 跟着主语变：her message；用的话不多，意思却传到了。
cards.example: Short sentences help you get your message across.

cards.note: to talk to someone you have not seen for a while and hear their news
cards.tip: 落下的进度补上来；跟上谁用 with：catch up with the class。
cards.example: Let's grab a coffee next week and catch up.

cards.note: to relax and not work too hard
to make a place clean and neat by putting things where they belong
to have a good effect on someone or something
cards.tip: 对谁有影响用 to；加强语气：make a big / real difference。没影响：make no difference。
cards.example: A good manager can make a big difference to a team.
